expectations.text: Recommends moving checks down to faster unit or integration tests
expectations.evidence: Re-level each test: rules to unit, API+DB to integration; delete duplicates

expectations.text: Keeps only a few end-to-end journeys and names which ones
expectations.evidence: '3-5 journeys... sign in, add a care task, a caregiver sees the shared update'

expectations.text: Treats flaky tests as bugs to be diagnosed
expectations.evidence: 'Flaky tests are bugs. Fix the cause (timing, shared state, network)'

expectations.text: Does not tell the user to adopt a new test framework without asking
